Calling these 'self-limited problems that rarely support high complexity' overreaches; a UTI is not self-limited.","'Appears in every complexity tier, roughly double the all-provider share at each level' is not accurate: the 0-condition tier is 0.041 vs 0.028 (about 1.5x), and the 5+ tier is 0.51 vs 0.218 (about 2.3x).
